text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Ikuno Dictus missed out on victory. 
However, she was able to run with all her 
might to the very end.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And as Tokai Teio returned to the turf, 
Ikuno Dictus welcomed her back with the 
warm words, "Welcome home."

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Though victory had eluded her, a look of 
quiet satisfaction rested on Ikuno 
Dictus's face.
